Claim 1 (Currently amended): A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, __a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes__, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member.

Claim 2 (Previously presented): The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 __wherein said light dispersing optic element__ further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim __3__ wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material.

Claim 5 (Previously presented): The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __and said light dispersing optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body__.

Claim 7 (Previously presented): The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section.

Claim 8 (Previously presented): The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body.

Claim 9 (Previously presented): The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __and said light dispersing optic element comprises a single optic element disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said single diode__.

Claim 11 (Previously presented): The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/ mK.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 9 __wherein__ including a single optic element is disposed between each adjacent fin over-lapping said diode __and a single diode resides on each face__.

Claim 13 (Previously presented): The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and said electronics module is configured to provide constant current drive to said light emitting diodes__.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim __1__ wherein said __light dispersing__ optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body.

Claim 16 (Currently amended): A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/ mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, __a light dispersing optic element overlapping said light emitting diodes__, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline.

Claim 17 (Currently amended): A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/ mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body__, attaching a light dispersing optic element overlapping said at least one light emitting diode,__ and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode.

Claim 18 (Previously presented): The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/ mK.

Claim 19 (Previously presented): The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins.

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The method of claim __19__ wherein said body has substantially straight side walls.
